title: Bridgeboard Huddle — UI, Rollouts & Analytics — 2026-04-07
content:
Attendees: Maya, Jordan, Sofia, Liam, Chen, Asha
Location: Zoom + #console-tooling channel
Date: 2026-04-07 10:00 PT
Purpose: quick cross-cut on the Bridgeboard feature rollout, UI polish items blocking canary, and analytics queries we need for the rollout guardrails. Keep it loose; this is working-area notes.

1) Status snapshot
- Bridgeboard feature branch merged into staging yesterday; initial canary scheduled for Mon 2026-04-12 if no regressions.
- Canary plan: 5% traffic for first 24h -> 20% next 48h -> 100% after health checks.
- Current blocked tickets that would force delay: CT-1189 (header overflow causing scroll jump on narrow widths), CT-1192 (rollout metrics missing event for fallback path).
- Observability: basic dashboard created (PR#4321) but needs two additional metrics: latency P95 by route, and percent of requests hitting fallback model.

2) UI items (owner -> status / notes)
- CT-1189 Header overflow (owner: Jordan) -> repro on mobile, possible cause is new nav pill CSS. Temporary fix: hide secondary nav on <420px; longer-term: reflow changes. Jordan to ship hotfix branch by 2026-04-08 EOD.
- CT-1204 Accessibility audit notes (owner: Sofia) -> focus outlines inconsistent post-theme update. Sofia to compile small PR with 3 small fixes; aim for 2026-04-09.
- Microcopy: 'Rollback' wording confusing in the console rollout modal (owner: Maya) -> changed to 'Revert to previous variant' draft in doc; collect legal/UX signoff. Action: Maya to ping UX and Legal in thread.

3) Rollouts & gating logic
- Canary policy review (Liam) -> we need an automated abort if fallback > 1% AND error rate increases by +0.5% vs baseline. Current rollout engine supports threshold-based aborts but not combined condition.
  - Short-term: implement two separate triggers (fallback threshold + error rate threshold) and mark them as both required in the rollout manifest. Liam to prototype and attach sample manifest by 2026-04-09.
  - Long-term: add composite conditions to the rollout engine (platform ticket P-789).
- Traffic shaping: decide whether to route by session affinity or by deterministic hashing. Decision: deterministic hashing to avoid sticky sessions complexity; may revisit for long-running interactions.

4) Analytics & dashboards (Chen + Asha)
- Missing event: 'rollout_fallback_triggered' (CT-1192) -> urgent; without it we can't observe canary health properly. Chen to add instrumentation in the runtime shim, Asha to add ETL pipeline mapping. Target: 2026-04-08 morning.
- Dashboards: add P95 by route and model variant. Asha to add query templates and a saved dashboard in Grafana. Need sample data for one business route to validate.
- Experiment metrics: add cohort retention (do users return within 2 minutes after encountering fallback?). Analytics question: does fallback correlate with user abandonment? Create a short experiment plan to capture session-level spans.

5) Risks / open questions
- Risk: rollback experience is confusing for platform users; we should ensure 'revert' action triggers a postmortem checklist so SREs can triage quickly. Owner: Maya + SRE oncall.
- Capacity: Dedicated pools are near saturation on eu-west-1 for the models the canary uses. If traffic spike due to a bug occurs, fallback to hosted may have different cost profile. Need a pre-approval from infra for burst capacity. Action: Jordan to open infra sync ticket and cc product.
- Telemetry lag: current pipeline has a median 3-minute ingest lag; for canary we prefer <1m for key signals. Asha to explore low-latency stream for the canary period (temporary).

6) Decisions made in meeting
- Proceed with canary on 2026-04-12 if CT-1189 hotfix lands and CT-1192 instrumentation is merged.
- Use deterministic hashing for traffic assignment.
- Add two separate automatic abort triggers for fallback rate and error rate; prototype manifest to be used during canary.

7) Action items (owner -> due)
- Jordan: ship CT-1189 hotfix branch and QA notes -> due 2026-04-08 EOD.
- Chen: push 'rollout_fallback_triggered' event into runtime shim and add unit test -> due 2026-04-08 AM.
- Asha: ETL mapping + Grafana dashboard with P95 by route and variant -> due 2026-04-09.
- Sofia: accessibility PR for focus outlines -> due 2026-04-09.
- Liam: sample rollout manifest prototype for dual-trigger gating -> due 2026-04-09.
- Maya: draft microcopy change and request UX/Legal signoff -> due 2026-04-10.
- Jordan: infra burst-capacity ticket -> due 2026-04-08.

8) Blockers needing immediate escalation
- If CT-1189 cannot be resolved by EOD 04-08, consider delaying canary by one week. Please escalate to Eng Director if approvals required.
- If telemetry lag can't be reduced, we will run a more conservative canary (5% for 72h) to buy time.

9) Notes to self / scribbles
- Consider adding a 'canary dry-run' mode that replays traffic without affecting routing to verify metrics pipeline end-to-end.
- Quick UX idea: inline rollout diff viewer in the modal for easier peer reviews.
- Reminder: record short runbook video for oncall SRE showing how to abort and rollback.

Meeting adjourned: 10:35 PT
Next check-in: async updates in #console-tooling and a 20-min follow-up on 2026-04-09 09:30 PT if blockers persist.

References / links mentioned in convo:
- Confluence: Bridgeboard rollout plan (linked above)
- Jira: CT-1189, CT-1192, CT-1204
- GitHub: console PR #4321 (dashboard), runtime shim changes TBD

Status history (quick):
- 2026-04-07 created; initial notes and assigned actions.
- 2026-04-08 minor edits adding due dates and infra ticket link.

Unresolved: list of follow-up items to confirm in next sync: exact manifest schema for composite gating, low-latency telemetry feasibility, legal signoff on microcopy.
